runtime_forecast.formula: setup + sum(each measured complete case time / measured steps * main steps) + scaled retention + report allowance. Complete case times already include I/O/diagnostics; no double addition.
assumptions: Same exact model/runner/report code, same VM limits and sequential execution.
For phase inputs use same-model mixture timing; sparse multiplication shape fixed but compression/diagnostic cost may differ.
One initial checkpoint per benchmark causes conservative repeated overhead in scaling.
Report allowance 10 seconds vs measured calibration 0.241 seconds, scaled for 9648 rather than 234 snapshots.
Main horizon fixed T200; no conditional extension; queue and GitHub publication excluded.

retention.full: all states every 1 and all 164 observables every .2
retention.report: RESULT.md <=24KiB; all cases; 31 specified series observables .2 through 20 then 2; global all-observable extrema/mean/std over every sample; counts and failures; snapshots not published

protocol.primary_question: Compare PS-PP and QS-QP flow at T200 at fixed formation; rate/action control PS-PQ and QS-QQ; no damage/recovery in this run.
interpretation_limits: Own-channel protection is not a full dark subspace or BIC.
P and S do not match all-state event rates.
Currents are signed and sink storage term must be retained.
Only base has full-horizon step-halving and four-phase ensemble checks.
No E002, J0, self-repair or quantum-advantage claim.

gate.measurement_scope: Entry-point monotonic clock through report preparation; final writes and interpreter shutdown excluded. Authoritative whole-process duration must be checked from published run.json.
